description: Header file defining the CfAudioDeviceModule class, which implements WebRTC audio device module interface and acts as an audio source for the Cuttlefish project. It declares methods related to audio device management, initialization, playback, recording, and volume controls, specific to the WebRTC integration within the project's audio subsystem.

classes.name: CfAudioDeviceModule
classes.description: Implements an audio device module for WebRTC with additional integration as an audio source, managing device configuration, playback, and recording functionalities.

methods.name: GetMoreAudioData
methods.description: Retrieves additional audio data for playback or processing, indicating stream state.

methods.name: ActiveAudioLayer
methods.description: Returns the currently active audio layer used by the device.

methods.name: RegisterAudioCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for audio transport that handles PCM data.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the audio device module.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the audio device module.

methods.name: PlayoutDevices

methods.name: RecordingDevices
